c92f0be683d24815.description: Namaa Partners is hiring a Junior Operations Analyst to support the operational side of the firm's mandates: the reporting, tracking and working documents that let a principal walk into a board or committee meeting with numbers that hold up. The hire carries the recurring cadence from the start, keeping engagement reporting accurate and current across active mandates, and building a clear operating picture of how the firm runs its work. This is an entry-level role with real accountability for the material other people rely on. You will work from Riyadh on a hybrid basis, alongside principals and analysts. About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a strategy advisory firm working mostly with organizations in Saudi Arabia and with companies that have significant interests there. The work covers corporate strategy, growth and market entry, operating model and efficiency, organization and talent, digital strategy, performance improvement, and governance and risk. Clients include family groups and their holding companies, listed corporations, private equity portfolio companies, banks and insurers, government entities, and industrial operators. Principals scope the mandates and then deliver them, so the analysis that enters a decision is the analysis of the people who signed it. What You Will Do Maintain the active mandate tracker: engagement status, key dates, named owners and the next decision point, updated weekly and circulated before Monday. Build and refresh the reporting packs that principals take into board and committee meetings, checking that every figure traces back to its source before it leaves the office. Sit in on internal scoping and staffing conversations, take the notes, and turn them into a short written record with owners and dates attached. Pull together the firm's operating data on mandate pipeline, utilization and engagement economics, and flag where the numbers have moved. Prepare the first draft of client working documents such as issue logs, action registers and meeting minutes, then revise them with the principal who owns the mandate. Keep templates and reference material for recurring deliverables consistent, so a new engagement does not start from a blank page. What We Need From You A bachelor's degree, or an equivalent record of structured analytical work you can describe plainly. Comfort with spreadsheets and slide decks: you can build a clean model of a small dataset and format a page without being asked to fix it twice. Writing that another person can read once and act on. Short sentences, clear headings, no filler. Care with numbers. You check a total against its parts before you send it, not after someone asks. Arabic and English, spoken and written, at a level that lets you follow a client conversation and write up what was decided. Willingness to ask what a term means when a client uses it and you are not certain, rather than guessing at it in a document. How Decisions Get Made The principal who scopes a mandate staffs it and stays with it through delivery. They set what the engagement needs week to week and sign off on anything that goes to a client. As the analyst on a mandate, you report to that principal and to the engagement lead they name, and your tracking documents are part of how they judge where a piece of work actually stands. If something is slipping, the expectation is that you raise it early in plain terms rather than at the deadline. Your read on the numbers is one of the inputs before a decision is taken. What The Role Offers This is a permanent, full-time position based in Riyadh, working on a hybrid arrangement. You will see how mandates are scoped and staffed from the inside, sit close to the working sessions where a view gets formed, and learn what a defensible number looks like when a board is asking about it. The exposure spans family groups, listed corporations, financial institutions and government entities, across strategy, operating model and performance work. It is a role for someone who wants to learn the craft by doing the operational part of it properly. People do well here when they write, when they are comfortable working through ambiguity in a client's own vocabulary, and when they are content to be accountable for a number. You will often be given a question and a rough deadline rather than a set of steps. What matters is that the tracker is current, the pack is right, and the principal who opens it knows what it says before the meeting starts. If that way of working suits you, the first year will be spent learning more about how decisions get made than most junior roles allow.

c981b2a4a8bbc594.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة خشيم للمعدات الصناعيه و الكهربائية عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء وترويج المنتجات الصناعية والكهربائية، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات البيع وتحصيل الديون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات) لتقديم عروض بيع دقيقة. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم بشكل مباشر لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يتطلب العمل تفاعلاً مباشراً مع العملاء وزيارات ميدانية لترويج المنتجات وإتمام عمليات البيع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

c90372e5eeaf02eb.description: Job description From Land to Sea – Active Experiences in Nature’s Purest Form Red Sea Sports & Entertainment (RSSE) is a dedicated subsidiary of Red Sea Global (RSG) , responsible for designing and delivering outstanding land and marine experiences at The Red Sea destination . RSSE manages and operates a diverse portfolio of sports, adventure, and leisure offerings, including water sports through Galaxea , adventure activities via Akun , and leisure experiences delivered by WAMA . RSSE plays a key strategic role in the partnership between Red Sea Global and the Saudi Olympic & Paralympic Committee , united by a shared ambition to promote inclusive, accessible, and world-class sports and recreational experiences. Guided by a purpose-driven approach and a strong commitment to people and the planet, RSSE delivers innovative programs aligned with Saudi Vision 2030 , supporting the Kingdom’s ambition to become a global leader in regenerative tourism. Job Purpose The Water Sports Instructor is a site-based role responsible for the safe, professional, and engaging delivery of water sports activities within the designated asset. This role ensures guests receive high-quality instruction, guidance, and supervision across a range of water-based activities while maintaining the highest standards of safety, service excellence, and operational discipline. The Water Sports Instructor plays a key role in delivering memorable guest experiences within a luxury marine tourism environment, while supporting daily operations and equipment readiness. Key Responsibilities 1. General Responsibilities Deliver water sports activities and instruction in a safe, professional, and engaging manner. Provide clear briefings and demonstrations to guests prior to all activities. Supervise guests during all water-based activities to ensure safety and enjoyment. Support the Water Sports / Dive Center Manager in daily operational requirements. Maintain a professional appearance and uphold luxury hospitality standards at all times. Assist with equipment setup, breakdown, and general operational readiness. 2. Pre-Opening Support Assist in the setup and operational readiness of water sports facilities, equipment, and activity areas. Support cross-functional teams during the delivery phase to ensure operational standards and safety requirements are met. Contribute to the familiarization of activity locations, equipment, and safety procedures. 3. Operational Responsibilities (Post-Opening) Conduct water sports sessions including (but not limited to): kayaking, paddle boarding, snorkeling, wake activities, and other approved marine activities. Ensure all guests are properly fitted with equipment and briefed on safety procedures. Monitor environmental and weather conditions to ensure safe activity delivery. Maintain and inspect all water sports equipment to ensure safety and functionality. Report and escalate any equipment damage or safety concerns immediately. Provide exceptional guest service and ensure a high-quality, enjoyable experience. Assist in organizing daily activity schedules and guest allocations. Support inventory tracking and basic equipment maintenance records. 4. Health, Safety, Environment & Quality Ensure safety is the highest priority in all water sports activities. Enforce compliance with all safety protocols, risk assessments, and emergency procedures. Conduct regular equipment checks and ensure all gear is safe for use. Promote environmental awareness and responsible use of marine environments. Ensure adherence to company and regulatory safety standards at all times. 5. Policies, Procedures & Reporting Follow all company policies, SOPs, and operational guidelines. Maintain accurate records of activities, incidents, and equipment usage where required. Report any operational issues, guest concerns, or safety risks promptly to management. 6. Continuous Improvement Contribute to the improvement of guest experience, safety practices, and operational efficiency. Support the development of new water sports experiences and activity offerings. Participate in training and upskilling programs as required. Job Requirements Qualifications & Experience Certification in water sports instruction or lifeguarding (e.g., ISA, RYA, ISA Watersports, or equivalent). Previous experience in water sports instruction, marine tourism, or resort operations. Strong understanding of water safety, rescue techniques, and risk management. Experience working in hospitality or guest-facing environments is preferred. First Aid and CPR certification (valid and up to date). Core Competencies Strong communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage. Excellent guest service mindset with a proactive, “can-do” attitude. High level of responsibility and commitment to safety. Ability to work in dynamic outdoor and marine environments. Strong teamwork and coordination skills. Ability to engage with diverse cultures and high-end clientele. Professional appearance aligned with luxury hospitality standards. Ability to remain calm and effective in emergency situations. Good organizational and time-management skills. Desirable Skills Additional language proficiency (preferably Arabic). Lifeguard certification or advanced water rescue training. Experience with multiple water sports disciplines. Knowledge of marine life and environmental conservation. Experience in luxury resort or high-end tourism environments. Job Context Operates within a luxury marine tourism and water sports environment. Requires flexibility to work outdoors, including weekends and peak seasons. Involves direct guest interaction and hands-on activity delivery. Exposure to varying marine and weather conditions is expected. Plays a key role in delivering safe, fun, and memorable guest experiences. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

c9722dde23a6b781.description: About the Role Penspen is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer (Rotating) to join its engineering team. This full-time position is based in Al Khafji, Eastern region, and is integral to a major Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) project. The role requires leading rotating equipment engineering activities and ensuring compliance with industry standards. Role Context and Project Focus The Senior Mechanical Engineer will be a key contributor to significant oil and gas projects, specifically within the FEED, detailed design, and EPC phases. Familiarity with Saudi Aramco standards and prior experience in major brownfield FEED/EPC projects will be considered an advantage for candidates. Key Responsibilities Lead rotating equipment engineering activities across FEED, detailed design, and EPC phases for oil & gas projects. Develop data sheets, specifications, and requisitions for various rotating equipment, including compressors, pumps, turbines, blowers, and packaged systems. Review vendor offers, perform technical bid evaluations, and participate in vendor meetings and design reviews. Ensure all work complies with API, ASME, ISO, and other relevant international standards. Coordinate with process, piping, instrumentation, and electrical disciplines to ensure seamless equipment integration. Review vendor documents such as GA drawings, datasheets, and performance curves, ensuring timely approval. Provide technical support during the procurement, fabrication, installation, and commissioning phases of projects. Participate in HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, and design review workshops. Mentor junior engineers and review their deliverables for quality and accuracy. Support client and internal audits, ensuring adherence to project quality and safety standards. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in mechanical engineering, specifically with rotating equipment. Proven experience in leading engineering activities for oil & gas projects. Familiarity with Saudi Aramco standards is advantageous. Experience in major brownfield FEED/EPC projects is beneficial. Work Environment This is a full-time position within Penspen's engineering team, focused on a major FEED project. The role is based in Al Khafji, Eastern region. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this Senior Mechanical Engineer (Rotating) position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c974d121f93565e4.description: Our client is one of the Kingdom's leading logistics, express and last-mile delivery groups, entering a significant transformation and growth phase. They are appointing a Chief Commercial Officer to own the commercial agenda end to end, restore profitable growth, and build a modern, high-performing and increasingly Saudi commercial organisation ahead of the group's next stage of scale. Reports to Chief Executive Officer; executive leadership team Location Riyadh, Kingdom-wide remit Designation Saudi nationals strongly preferred The mandate , what success looks like Own the commercial P&L , revenue, margin, and profitable new business across corporate, national / industry, and regional sales. Restore growth and rebuild the commercial engine , structure, account coverage, targets, and performance discipline. Lead sales, marketing, pricing and customer experience as one aligned commercial function. Own key-account and government / giga-project relationships at the most senior level. Drive Saudization of the commercial front line and build the Saudi commercial-leadership pipeline. Rebuild the incentive and pricing-governance framework , rewarding profitable new business, simple, timely, and well governed. Partner with operations and technology to turn commercial strategy into delivered service and customer value. The person we are looking for A proven senior commercial leader (CCO / VP Commercial / Commercial Director) in logistics, courier / express, supply chain, or a comparable large B2B service sector . Demonstrated P&L ownership and a track record of profitable revenue growth and commercial turnaround . Deep Saudi / GCC market knowledge, with established key-account and government / giga-project relationships . A strong leader of scaled, multi-region commercial teams , with proven Saudization delivery . Commercial and financial acumen (pricing, margin, deal governance) and the stakeholder skill to drive change in a transforming organisation. Arabic and English. Saudi nationals and Saudi-market-proven leaders strongly preferred.

c9870c819f8970c5.description: We're looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Architectural Engineer with strong experience in hospitality fit-out projects , joinery detailing, and FF&E coordination. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Architecture. 7–10 years of experience in architectural fit-out projects. Proven experience in hotel and hospitality projects (mandatory) . Strong expertise in joinery shop drawings, detailing, and material specifications. Hands-on experience in FF&E coordination and procurement. Excellent coordination skills with design, MEP, suppliers, and site teams. Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, and relevant design software. Experience in 4- and 5-star hotel projects is a strong advantage. Key Responsibilities: Prepare, review, and coordinate architectural and joinery shop drawings. Manage FF&E technical coordination, specifications, and procurement requirements. Resolve technical issues and coordinate with consultants, contractors, and suppliers. Ensure technical submissions and site execution comply with approved designs, specifications, and quality standards.

c9acffd8df983466.description: Job Purpose: The Cost Control Specialist owns the company's annual OPEX and CAPEX budget cycle and keeps spending on plan. The role builds and maintains the financial models required by lenders, shareholders and the Grantor, tracks every project and department against budget, and flags overruns early with a mitigation plan. It ensures all costs are captured in line with IFRS, SOCPA and regulatory requirements, and gives senior management and the Board clear, timely reporting on cost performance. Job Responsibilities: Lead annual OPEX and CAPEX budget preparation with department heads; challenge assumptions and enforce alignment with corporate strategy. Review and validate financial data from departments to ensure accuracy and completeness. Develop the budget template, timelines, guidelines and procedures. Develop the annual traffic forecast in coordination with the Slots Department for budgeting purposes, with external advisors' assistance if necessary. Develop and update financial models for CAPEX projects in line with lender, shareholder and Grantor requirements. Work with the Strategy and Treasury departments to develop financial models for new business and investment opportunities; validate assumptions with related departments. Coordinate with lenders on project finance reporting, budget vs. actual and compliance certificates under the financing agreements and develop the related lender reports. Monitor cost vs. budget for each OPEX and CAPEX project and each department; flag overruns early and propose mitigation plans. Analyze cost drivers and identify savings and efficiency opportunities. Maintain cost control systems in the ERP, ensuring WBS elements, cost centers and internal orders are set up correctly. Validate all fixed asset capitalization before it is recorded in the ERP. Drive automation of budget reporting and reduce manual consolidation time. Work with Operations and project teams to validate scope changes and their budget impact before management approval. Establish cost control policies, approval matrices and guidelines for project controls. Partner with Procurement on contract commitments, accruals and PO tracking to prevent budget leakage. Prepare the Board and Management Pack, including KPI dashboards, cost trends, commitments vs. actuals and forecast outlook. Ensure all costs are captured in line with IFRS, SOCPA and other regulatory requirements. Support internal and external audits on budget, accruals, CAPEX capitalization and project finance reporting. Provide monthly, quarterly and annual budget performance reports to senior management. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal financial policies and procedures. Education requirements: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field. Certification Requirements: Professional certification preferred: CMA, CPA, ACCA, SOCPA or CFA. Experience: Minimum 3 years in budgeting, cost control or FP&A, ideally in airports, infrastructure, aviation or a concession/PPP environment. Languages: Fluent in Arabic & English (required). Technical Skills: Experience with ERP cost control modules (e.g. SAP CO/PS or Oracle), including WBS, cost centers and internal orders. Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills; experience with BI tools (e.g. Power BI) is an advantage.

c9b4630ff87980d8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت، والتحقيق في الحوادث، وإعداد الإجراءات والتقارير اللازمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مشرف الصحة والسلامة المهنية مسؤولية متابعة وتطبيق اللوائح والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة، بالإضافة إلى المهام التالية: إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل لضمان الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز واستخدام أجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار مع الجهات المختصة. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيقات اللازمة، وتوثيق النتائج بشكل دقيق. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن، وخطط الإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية والخاصة، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معرفة قوية بالقوانين واللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على استخدام أجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية المختلفة. مهارات ممتازة في التحقيق في الحوادث وإعداد التقارير. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل فعالة لشرح التعليمات والإجراءات للعاملين. القدرة على إعداد وتوثيق التقارير بدقة ووضوح. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد المخاطر واقتراح الحلول. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع المهام. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جازان، وتتطلب العمل ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

c9b97194b3f8e6d8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة طرق التنمية للمقاولات عن مهندس زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة خصائص التربة الزراعية، وتصميم شبكات الري والصرف، وتحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة خصائص التربة الزراعية الفيزيائية والكيميائية ومكوناتها. متابعة فحص عينات النبات والتربة ومياه الري وتحليل نتائجها. دراسة واختبار أنواع الأسمدة المناسبة وتقييم مدى استجابة المزروعات لها. دراسة أنظمة الري واختيار الأنسب منها (كالري السطحي أو بالرشاشات أو المحوري أو الموضعي). تصميم مخططات وشبكات الري والصرف الزراعي ومتابعة إجراءات التركيب. تقييم كفاءة أنظمة الري وتطويرها. تحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة (كآلات الحراثة والزراعة والرش والحصاد وآلات جرش وخلط الحبوب). إعداد برامج تشغيل وصيانة الآلات الزراعية والتأكد من جاهزيتها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الزراعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الزراعية. فهم عميق لخصائص التربة ومكوناتها. معرفة بأنظمة الري والصرف الزراعي وتصميمها. القدرة على تحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة وإدارة تشغيلها وصيانتها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة طرق التنمية للمقاولات في مدينة جدة، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور العمل الميداني والمكتبي لدعم المشاريع الزراعية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

c9ee4628904e426a.description: Job Overview We are looking for an experienced Procurement Manager Logistics & Supply Chain to manage procurement activities for a logistics company, ensuring cost-effective purchasing, reliable supplier relationships, and timely availability of goods and services. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business needs. Source, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers and service providers. Manage purchasing of logistics, transportation, warehousing, and operational requirements. Negotiate prices, contracts, payment terms, and delivery schedules. Monitor supplier performance, quality, costs, and delivery timelines. Manage purchase orders, contracts, and procurement documentation. Coordinate with Operations, Finance, and Warehouse teams. Identify cost-saving opportunities and ensure procurement policy compliance. Key Skills Procurement Strategy | Supplier Management | Contract Negotiation | Cost Optimization | Logistics & Supply Chain | Vendor Relations | Inventory & Purchasing Management Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in procurement, preferably within logistics or supply chain. Strong supplier network and negotiation skills. Experience in cost control, vendor management, and purchasing operations. Good knowledge of procurement processes and ERP systems. Strong communication and analytical skills. English required; Arabic is an advantage. Saudi market experience preferred.

c90b68de42f4ad7d.description: About the Role BMC is seeking a Senior Marketing Executive to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah al Mukarramah. This full-time role serves as the primary operational link between the Corporate Marketing Department and an assigned branch, ensuring corporate marketing strategies are effectively translated into high-quality local execution. The Senior Marketing Executive will proactively identify opportunities to strengthen the branch’s visibility, community presence, partnerships, and student engagement while operating within established strategic directions and brand frameworks. Key Responsibilities Execute marketing campaigns, initiatives, and projects in accordance with Corporate Marketing strategy and priorities. Translate corporate marketing plans into effective branch-level activities and activations. Ensure all marketing activities, communications, and materials comply with approved brand guidelines and maintain consistent institutional messaging. Identify and propose relevant local marketing opportunities, activations, conferences, exhibitions, and community events. Develop initiatives that strengthen relationships between the branch and its surrounding community, including health awareness campaigns and educational initiatives. Lead the on-ground marketing execution of branch events such as open days, graduation ceremonies, and student fairs. Serve as the marketing point of contact for approved student-led activities and guide student clubs on branding and promotional requirements. Identify compelling branch stories, achievements, and community impact opportunities for corporate communication channels. Ensure accurate collection, validation, and submission of leads generated through events and other branch marketing activities, maintaining data accuracy in the designated CRM system. Monitor local market trends, competitor activities, and student preferences within the assigned region, providing actionable insights to Corporate Marketing. Qualifications and Experience 6-10 years of experience in marketing. Experience managing marketing activities within a multi-branch or multi-location organization is highly preferred. Experience in the higher education, healthcare, or service sector in Saudi Arabia is an advantage. Reporting and Coordination Provide Corporate Marketing with regular updates and reports on branch activities, market developments, and emerging opportunities. Coordinate closely with Corporate Marketing teams to ensure timely delivery of campaigns and required marketing materials. Work closely with Corporate Content, Social Media, and Creative teams to ensure timely delivery of relevant materials. Community and Partnership Engagement Build productive relationships with relevant local organizations, community partners, and stakeholders. Support the marketing aspects of MOUs, partnerships, and strategic alliances, ensuring appropriate activation and promotion. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time position in Jeddah, Makkah al Mukarramah. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c94650be4098af76.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نفحات القهوة لتقديم المشروبات عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم خدمة عملاء متميزة من خلال التعامل مع الاستفسارات والشكاوى والطلبات بكفاءة واحترافية، مما يضمن رضا العملاء ويحافظ على الصورة المهنية للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال استفسارات العملاء والرد عليها بوضوح ودقة. استقبال الشكاوى والبلاغات من العملاء ومتابعتها حتى الحل. معالجة طلبات العملاء والتنسيق الفعال مع الأقسام المختصة لضمان إنجازها. متابعة جميع الحالات المتعلقة بالعملاء حتى إغلاقها بشكل كامل. توثيق الشكاوى والطلبات وتحديث بياناتها في الأنظمة المخصصة. إعداد تقارير دورية حول شكاوى العملاء وملاحظاتهم لتقييم الأداء. المساهمة في تحسين تجربة العملاء ورفع مستوى رضاهم عن الخدمات. الالتزام بسياسات الشركة ومعايير جودة الخدمة المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى العملاء بكفاءة واحترافية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهيًا وكتابيًا. المهارات المطلوبة الاحترافية في التعامل مع العملاء. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرار. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق خدمة العملاء في جدة، مكة المكرمة. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تطوير مهارات الموظفين. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

c979382faf80e039.description: About the Role * Naghi Motors is seeking a Data Protection Specialist to join its team in Makkah or Jeddah. This full-time role involves supporting the Data Protection Officer in the implementation, operation, and monitoring of the organization’s data protection framework. The specialist will focus on execution, documentation, monitoring activities, and coordination to ensure compliance with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and other applicable data protection regulations. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation and ongoing operation of the data protection framework in line with Saudi PDPL and internal policies. Assist in monitoring compliance with data protection policies, procedures, and controls across business units. Support material planning and daily stock issuance. Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as stock turnover, wastage, and availability. c98b7f45dbf8d1dd.description: Operate and monitor well testing equipment safely and efficiently during wellsite operations. Operate equipment including separators, manifolds, chokes, flow lines, sand traps, heaters and associated well testing systems as required. Monitor equipment performance and report any abnormal conditions, leaks or equipment defects. Assist with troubleshooting and basic maintenance of well testing equipment. Verify completed works against contract requirements, project progress, and agreed payment mechanisms. Prepare payment assessments and commercial recommendations. Monitor project costs, commitments, liabilities, and expenditure against approved budgets. Maintain accurate commercial records and reporting. c9bc10e5b7f098a0.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة يبحث مركز سمير عباس الطبي عن فني مختبر طبي للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إجراء الفحوصات المخبرية المتنوعة، وتشغيل وصيانة المعدات، وتقديم النتائج بدقة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة عالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد وتشغيل وصيانة معدات حفظ وفحص العينات، وضبطها ومراقبتها وفقاً لنوع الفحص المطلوب. دراسة طلبات الأطباء لتحديد الفحوصات المطلوبة، وسحب عينات الدم، واستلام عينات البول والبراز، مع تدوين بيانات المرضى وحفظ العينات بشكل صحيح. تحضير العينات للفحص والزراعة، واختيار مواد الفحص بالكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء الفحوصات المخبرية المختلفة، بما في ذلك التحاليل الكيميائية والفيزيائية والمجهرية على العينات. استخراج النتائج وتوثيقها، وتقديمها للاختصاصي المشرف. إتلاف العينات المخبرية بعد الانتهاء من الفحوصات وتوثيق إجراءات الإتلاف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المختبرات الطبية. القدرة على تشغيل وصيانة معدات المختبر. معرفة بأسس سحب العينات وحفظها وإتلافها. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات المخبرية بدقة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة في مركز سمير عباس الطبي. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.

c9d073010c7c23ec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الثوب العالمي للصناعة عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات شاملة للعملاء بخصوص المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر، وإصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات عند الحاجة. التعامل مع المنتجات الواردة والتأكد من ترتيبها وعرضها بشكل مناسب. تولي جميع أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة الدفع المختلفة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم المعلومات للعملاء بوضوح. القدرة على إدارة المخزون والحفاظ على تنظيم المتجر. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في مدينة الطائف بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. الدور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل شركة الثوب العالمي للصناعة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

c9fff98354f2184f.description: About the Role Brainlake is seeking a Senior Arabic & English Copywriter to join a 12-month remote contract engagement. c9eec082d3b0dfe1.description: Department: Rooms Division, Front Office & Guest Services Location: Saudi Arabia - Al Khobar Description The incumbent in this position is responsible for checking-in and checking-out Hotel guests in a friendly and caring manner according to the Kempinski procedures and Leading Quality Assurance (LQA) standards. Professional Mindset and Flexibility: Structured, proactive, and quality-focused approach to project delivery, with the ability to manage risk, change, and financial performance. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally across the MEA region as required.

c9944b2047f83bba.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كونيكت نتووركس عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية بناء علاقات مع العملاء، وعرض المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، ومتابعة التحصيلات. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات التي تقدمها الشركة. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين، مع توثيق بيانات الاتصال الخاصة بهم. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لتقديم عروض البيع وشرح مواصفات المنتجات وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء والتواصل الفعال. مهارات جيدة في التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات ضمن فريق شركة كونيكت نتووركس في المنطقة الشرقية، الدمام. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والزملاء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة قاعدة بيانات العملاء والتقارير. القدرة على تقديم عروض بيع واضحة ومقنعة. مهارات تحصيل الديون ومتابعة الحسابات. الالتزام بإعداد وتقديم التقارير الدورية بدقة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

c9ae0cd928954744.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الفارابي الطبية عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع الخطط العلاجية، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تجهيز وتركيب التعويضات السنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها لتشخيص حالات الفم والأسنان بدقة. إعداد خطة العلاج المناسبة وبرنامجها الزمني لكل حالة مرضية. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات السنية، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها ومعالجة التهاباتها، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للمرضى. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بجميع أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. شهادة جامعية في طب الأسنان. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن فريق طبي متخصص لتقديم أفضل رعاية صحية للمرضى. نوع الوظيفة دوام كامل. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب. للمهتمين، يرجى التقديم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

c9047da549274ace.description: Job Summary: We are looking for a friendly, efficient, and customer-oriented Barista to join our team. The Barista will be responsible for preparing and serving high-quality coffee, beverages, and light snacks, while providing excellent customer service and maintaining a clean, welcoming café environment. Key Responsibilities: Prepare and serve coffee, tea, and other beverages to company standards. Operate coffee machines, grinders, blenders, and other equipment safely. Greet and interact with customers in a friendly and professional manner. Take customer orders accurately and handle payments (cash/card). Maintain cleanliness and organization of the café, including tables, counters, and equipment. Follow hygiene, food safety, and health & safety regulations. Assist with stocking, inventory, and restocking supplies as needed. Upsell products and promote specials to enhance customer experience. Work effectively as part of a team to ensure smooth operations. Qualifications & Skills: Previous barista or customer service experience preferred (training may be provided). Knowledge of coffee brewing techniques and café equipment is a plus. Strong communication and customer service skills. Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment. Attention to detail, cleanliness, and quality. Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and holidays as required.

c92d3da1479645a6.description: About Daikin Saudi Daikin Saudi is a subsidiary of Daikin Middle East & Africa FZE, which is part of Daikin Industries Ltd. The company is a leading provider of heating, cooling, ventilation, air purification, and refrigeration technology. Daikin designs, manufactures, and supplies a broad portfolio of equipment and tailor-made solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial applications across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). About the Role Daikin Saudi is seeking an HVAC Technician - Industrial Refrigeration to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, specifically in the Al Dar Al Baida District. This full-time role involves the installation, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of HVAC systems to ensure reliable performance and high customer satisfaction. The position requires 2-5 years of experience, hands-on technical expertise, strong diagnostic capabilities, and adherence to safety and service quality standards. The technician will execute service activities independently on-site while coordinating with supervisors and service teams to meet contractual SLAs and operational targets. Key Responsibilities Perform installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of Air-Cooled Chiller, Centrifugal Chiller, VRV&DX, Industrial Refrigeration (Ammonia Plant), and Commercial Refrigeration systems. Diagnose electrical, mechanical, and control faults, and implement corrective actions efficiently. Support commissioning, operation, and maintenance activities to ensure systems operate according to OEM standards. Identify root causes of system issues to minimize repeat breakdowns. Optimize system performance through proper servicing, parameter checks, and minor adjustments. Escalate complex or recurring technical issues to supervisors as needed. Act as the on-site technical representative, maintaining professional communication with customers. Clearly explain service activities, findings, and recommendations to customers. Ensure high service quality and customer satisfaction during all visits. Complete service reports, checklists, and job documentation accurately and on time. Record system data, faults, and actions taken. Coordinate with supervisors, planners, and spare parts teams for smooth execution of tasks. Follow all safety procedures, PPE requirements, and permit systems. Ensure safe handling of tools, equipment, and refrigerants. Stay updated on product knowledge, service practices, and new HVAC technologies. Participate in training programs and apply learned skills in field activities. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in HVAC systems, with a focus on industrial refrigeration. Demonstrated hands-on technical expertise in installation, maintenance, and repair. Strong diagnostic capability for electrical, mechanical, and control faults. Ability to work independently on-site while coordinating with team members. Commitment to safety procedures and service quality standards. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates within a positive environment that values trust, creativity, and continuous improvement. Daikin is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace culture, providing opportunities for learning and professional growth.

c9a2c5245cd24494.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is seeking a Director of Operations for Botanica, a subsidiary specializing in sustainable greenery for Red Sea Global’s destinations. Botanica integrates new species with local flora, benefiting from shared strategic goals within the Red Sea Global group. The company manages over 1 million square meters, cultivating over 5 million plants since 2020 with a goal of 30 million by 2030, shaping the landscapes of The Red Sea and Amaala. This full-time position is based in Tabuk, specifically in Umluj and Tabuk, and requires over 10 years of experience. Role Purpose The Director of Operations will lead the operational functions of the 180-hectare Botanica site. This includes field operations and plant maintenance, plant protection, irrigation and water management (2,000–4,000 m3 per day from TSE and desalinated sources), soil mix and growing media, logistics, receiving and dispatch, and facilities, fleet, and workshops. The role ensures plant health, timely and complete order fulfillment, and safe and efficient site operations for all business units. This position is critical as failures in irrigation or equipment can lead to significant losses and project delays. Key Responsibilities Manage and organize all nursery areas, including planting zones (1,533,100 m2), shading (173,800 m2), and mother stock areas. Oversee routine maintenance of nursery stock, including weeding, pruning, spacing, cleaning, and daily plant health monitoring. Implement plant protection measures in accordance with the IPM and biosecurity program. Design, operate, and maintain the irrigation network and pump stations, setting irrigation schedules by zone and season. Monitor water quality, flow, and consumption, focusing on reducing freshwater use through TSE, drip, and smart irrigation. Develop and maintain contingency plans for water supply interruptions and system failures. Source raw materials and produce consistent soil mixes and substrates to approved recipes, supplying internal sections and external clients. Manage the receiving of local and imported plants and materials, coordinating with Biosecurity for inspection and quarantine. Plan and execute dispatch operations, including picking, loading, transport, and delivery documentation. Coordinate imports through the bonded facility and maintain accurate stock movement records. Implement preventive and corrective maintenance plans for facilities, greenhouses, shade structures, and equipment. Manage fleet availability, utilization, and compliance, overseeing workshops and the asset register. Manage the Nursery Operations budget, including labor, water, energy, fuel, spares, and maintenance. Allocate manpower, machinery, and transport across sections to support Production and Landscape Maintenance requests. Report KPIs monthly and identify operational risks early with corrective actions. Lead section heads, supervisors, and operatives, setting competency and training standards. Control high-risk activities in collaboration with HSSE, such as machinery, chemicals, lifting, driving, and heat stress. Ensure adherence to all relevant Botanica and RSG Group policies, delegation of authority (DoA), processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Champion the safety, quality, and environmental management system (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and the compliance management system (ISO 37301). Identify and lead opportunities for continuous improvement in departmental systems, processes, and practices, focusing on cost reduction, productivity, and client value. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in operations management. Demonstrated ability to manage large-scale operations, particularly in horticulture or similar fields. Experience with sustainable practices and environmental management systems. Strong leadership skills with experience in managing diverse teams. Proficiency in budget management and KPI reporting. Work Environment The Director of Operations will work in a fast-evolving environment, contributing to world-class projects in locations such as Umluj and Tabuk. The role involves working with industry experts and a team committed to ecological harmony, with 40% of the current team from the local community. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to sustainable development and biodiversity preservation at scale. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time Director Operation position with Red Sea Global are invited to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c9f43f39397e11ce.description: About the Role Hill International, Inc. is seeking a Quantity Surveyor to join their team in Al Qassim. This is a full-time position for a professional with over 10 years of experience in quantity surveying. The role involves managing project costs from initial estimation through to completion, ensuring financial oversight and contractual compliance. Key Responsibilities Estimate costs, material quantities, and project timelines, while liaising with various project teams to maintain progress. Review drawings and specifications for new projects to calculate material quantities, costs, labor, and time required. Provide early cost advice, budget, benchmark projects, and prepare life cycle cost plans. Support the preparation of tender and contract documents, including bills of quantities, in collaboration with clients and consultants. Conduct cost analysis for variations and claims, and provide advice on contractual claims and disputes. Value completed work, arrange payments, and ensure projects deliver value for money to clients. Prepare and submit cost estimates and budgets, conduct studies to estimate materials, time, and labor costs, and analyze outcomes to produce budget reports. Track changes in design and construction work, adjusting budget projections as necessary. Review and analyze contractor and supplier invoices for accuracy and compliance with contractual obligations. Collaborate with project managers, architects, and engineers to develop cost-effective solutions and resolve construction-related issues. Prepare and present regular reports to management on project costs, budget variances, and potential risks. Stay informed of industry trends and developments, integrating best practices into cost management processes. Adhere to Hill International's Quality, Environmental, Safety, and Occupational Health Policies, Manuals, and Procedures. Perform additional duties as assigned by the line manager or supervisor. Candidate Requirements The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in quantity surveying with a proven track record of managing project costs effectively. This role requires meticulous attention to detail and strong analytical skills. Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in Quantity Surveying is required. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Al Qassim, where the Quantity Surveyor will contribute to various projects under the management of Hill International, Inc. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for this role to contribute to significant projects within the region.

c9f7a1762edef126.description: About the Role EDITION is seeking a Spa Attendant to support various vital spa functions. This full-time role focuses on creating a memorable and unique experience for guests through spa services. The Spa Attendant will take initiative in delivering a range of services to ensure guest satisfaction. Key Duties and Tasks Promoting spa services or retail products. Scheduling reservations and confirming appointments. Providing information and answers about spa services. Checking in guests upon arrival. Processing payments for services. Responsibilities Creating and maintaining a safe workplace environment. Following all company policies and procedures. Upholding established quality standards for services. Ensuring professional uniform, personal appearance, and communications. Managing reservation software, including reading and visually verifying information. Taking a hands-on approach to work, which includes moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 10 pounds without assistance and 25 pounds with assistance. Reaching overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Performing other reasonable job duties as requested by management. Qualifications and Requirements Education: High school diploma or *** equivalent. Related Work Experience: No related work experience is required (0-1 years). Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience is required. License or Certification: None specified. About EDITION Hotels EDITION Hotels combine the vision of boutique hotelier Ian Schrager, the service delivery of a world-class luxury hotel, and the global reach of Marriott International. The brand aims to deliver a balanced experience of polish with personality, perfectionism with individualism, and comfort with charisma and charm. EDITION targets sophisticated consumers who value quality, originality, design, and service excellence without conventional limitations. Commitment to Diversity Marriott International is dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. The company fosters an environment where the unique backgrounds of associates are valued and celebrated, recognizing that its greatest strength lies in the diverse blend of culture, talent, and experiences. Marriott International is committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

c923563ddcfd582f.job_title: Supervisor Passenger Service Flynas JED Station
c923563ddcfd582f.description: About the Role Swissport KSA is seeking a Supervisor Passenger Service for Flynas at TUU Station in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing first-line leadership and guidance to employees within the Passenger Services Department, ensuring excellent customer service and operational compliance. The supervisor will manage all functions of the Passenger Services team during shifts to ensure timely flight departures and high customer satisfaction for both passengers and airlines. Key Responsibilities Perform all Passenger Service agent tasks in addition to supervisory duties. Lead, inspire, and coach the team to meet departmental goals and ensure compliance with KPIs and SOPs. Conduct Pre/Post Flight Editing and monitor attendance of all Passenger Handling staff (Check-in, MAAS/PRM). Organize daily staff briefings, assign and distribute work, and review for accuracy and completeness. Ensure cross-utilization of resources and monitor gate and transfer desk processes per flight according to SLAs. Liaise with the PRM team for special handling requests (WCHR/UM/DEPU) and coordinate flight close-out and dispatch paperwork. Manage queues at the departure terminal and ensure professionalism in all communications (email, radio, telex, telephone). Organize and manage resources during crisis situations such as flight disruptions, delays, or system breakdowns. Ensure procedures established by each carrier are carried out professionally to meet service delivery targets. Update reports for office equipment failures, discrepancies, and incidents. Ensure employee compliance with uniform, appearance, and PPE policies. Motivate staff, facilitate two-way communication, and recommend changes for operational efficiency. Develop or modify work plans, methods, and synergies, determining work priorities for each shift. Develop performance improvement plans, document performance, provide feedback, and formally evaluate employees. Seek customer feedback and opportunities for continuous improvement in service delivery. Track stationery inventory and place orders as needed from customer airlines. Ensure proper coverage for deviations from daily operations (*, extra flights, charters, delayed flights) and reconcile monies collected for ad-hoc services and excess baggage. Finalize all post-flight paperwork and activities, and hold debriefings as required. Investigate operational irregularities at the terminal and submit reports/recommendations. Report occurrences, events, violations, and acts affecting safety, security, and company reputation. Maintain an accurate log/inventory of support tools (radios, mobile phones, tablets, WCHRs) and report defects. Ensure accurate and prompt submission of data capture and daily reports using defined formats and Swissport reporting tools. Generate a summary report of all terminal activities after the end of each shift. Carry out additional duties as instructed by management. Qualifications and Competencies A minimum of three years of experience as a Passenger Service Agent. High School diploma. Demonstrated passion for customer service with relevant work experience. Proven ability in problem-solving and decision-making. Commitment to continuous improvement. A good understanding of all regulatory and recommended procedures related to the airport environment. Flexibility to work various shifts, including days, evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in passenger services, with at least three years specifically as a Passenger Service Agent. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, requiring adaptability to various shift schedules to support continuous airport operations.

c95e99ea112fc308.description: الوصف الوظيفي: تسويق المنتجات للعملاء والاجابة على استفساراتهم المهام الوظيفية: • الاتصال بالعملاء الحاليين والجدد عبر الهاتف والبريد الإلكتروني والزيارات لمناقشة احتياجاتهم . • تقديم عروض الأسعار وإتمام طلبات العملاء . • جدولة مواعيد المبيعات مع العملا ء لزيارتهم . • التواصل الدائم مع العملاء لمتابعة عملية البيع وتقييم مدى رضا العملاء عن الخدمات والمنتجات المُقدمة لهم . • إضافة حسابات جديدة إلى الشركة أمر لا بد منه ويمكن أن يؤثر على الأداء العام . • تقديم عروض المنتجات والخدمات بأساليب منطقية وجذابة تُقن ع العملاء الحاليين والمحتملين بفوائد ومزايا المنتج. • إبلاغ العميل بالصفقات والعروض الترويجية . • الإجابة على أسئلة العملاء حول المنتجات والأسعار والتوافر واستخدامات المنتج . • تسليم المنتج للعميل خلال الفترة المحددة للتسليم .

c96ab8fb08cf2fbe.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مستشفى الدكتور سمير محمد علي عباس عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم رعاية تمريضية شاملة للمرضى، مع التركيز على تقييم الحالات وتطوير خطط الرعاية وتنفيذها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمرضى وجمع البيانات منهم ومن ذويهم، ثم توثيقها وتحليلها لتحديد احتياجات الرعاية. إعداد خطط الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها بشكل دوري. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمرضى وعينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية وفقاً لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج، ومتابعة إرسالها للمختبر والحصول على النتائج وإبلاغ الطبيب بها. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية حسب توجيهات الطبيب المعالج، والمشاركة في عمليات الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي عند الحاجة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال التمريض والرعاية التمريضية لضمان تقديم أفضل الخدمات. توثيق جميع الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمرضى في السجل الطبي، وضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال جميع أعمال وعمليات التمريض. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمريض. القدرة على تقييم الحالات الصحية للمرضى بدقة وفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتعامل مع المرضى وذويهم. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم البيانات الصحية وتحديد احتياجات الرعاية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق متعدد التخصصات. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في تقديم الرعاية التمريضية. القدرة على التكيف مع التطورات المستمرة في ممارسات التمريض. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي التمريض في مستشفى الدكتور سمير محمد علي عباس بجدة، ضمن بيئة رعاية صحية ديناميكية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم أفضل مستويات الرعاية للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

c98f987f64a075d4.description: About the Role RAWAJ, a leading Saudi company specializing in IT Infrastructure, IT Security, Telecommunications, System Integration, and Digital Transformation, is seeking an IBM Guardium Security Engineer. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and requires 0-1 years of experience. The role focuses on database security and data activity monitoring, supporting the implementation, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of IBM Guardium solutions to protect sensitive data and ensure compliance with security requirements. Key Responsibilities Configure, monitor, and maintain IBM Guardium environments. Monitor database activity and identify suspicious or unauthorized access. Develop and manage Guardium policies, alerts, reports, and dashboards. Support database discovery, classification, vulnerability assessment, and auditing activities. Troubleshoot Guardium Collectors, Aggregators, S-TAPs, and related components. Collaborate with database and cybersecurity teams to investigate and respond to security incidents. Support compliance and audit requirements related to database security and data protection. Prepare security reports and provide recommendations to strengthen database security. Assist with Guardium upgrades, deployments, integrations, and ongoing maintenance. Document configurations, procedures, incidents, troubleshooting activities, and technical changes. Support the continuous improvement of database security monitoring and protection processes. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 1–2 years of hands-on experience with IBM Guardium or a similar Database Activity Monitoring (DAM) solution. Basic understanding of database technologies such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, or PostgreSQL. Knowledge of database security, auditing, access controls, and data protection. Familiarity with IBM Guardium S-TAP, Collectors, policies, reporting, and monitoring. Required Skills Good troubleshooting and analytical skills. Ability to investigate database security events and identify potential security risks. Good communication and collaboration skills. Experience with SIEM integration and security monitoring. Knowledge of DLP, DAM, vulnerability management, and security compliance frameworks. Experience working within a cybersecurity service provider, SOC, or security operations environment. Exposure to enterprise database security implementations and monitoring. Work Environment This role is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic team focused on delivering cutting-edge IT services and solutions.

c9a42e5309eb82a5.description: About Clarios Clarios produces advanced, low-voltage battery technologies and smart solutions for nearly every type of vehicle, powering 1 in 3 vehicles worldwide. The company is home to brands such as VARTA® and OPTIMA®, focusing on creating cutting-edge technology sustainably. The Role of Commercial Finance Manager, META The Commercial Finance Manager for the META region serves as the primary finance partner to the Sales and Commercial organization. This full-time role is critical in driving pricing discipline, profitability analysis, and credit risk management as Clarios expands its distributor and customer footprint across the META region. c9d99f59e1a3d348.description: About Lucid Motors Middle East Lucid Motors is dedicated to creating mobility experiences through innovation. The company develops vehicles based on proprietary technology and software-defined architecture, aiming to redefine segments with a focus on range, performance, design, and space. This position involves building the automation stack from initial commissioning through volume ramp to June 2027 SOP within a greenfield facility. The engineer will ensure standards, uptime, cybersecurity, and data integration for a ************** plant, operating through disciplined change control, objective launch evidence, cross-functional problem solving, and structured technical ownership transfer to the Saudi workforce. The role requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Define and enforce PLC architecture and coding standards across Siemens TIA Portal and Rockwell Studio 5000. Manage safety PLC deployment (Siemens F, Rockwell GuardLogix, Beckhoff TwinSAFE) and functional safety compliance. Maintain PLC program library, version-control repository, and control-system change management. Lead Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) for all automated Powertrain equipment. Own SCADA architecture and standards (Ignition, WinCC, or FactoryTalk View SE). Deploy and maintain historian systems (OSIsoft PI, Ignition Historian, or equivalent) for machine performance data. Manage MES integration for production tracking, quality traceability, and machine-signal integration (OPC-UA, SQL). Enforce OT cybersecurity standards, implement network segmentation, secure remote access, and patch management for OT assets. Coordinate with the IT/OT security team on vulnerability management and incident response. Drive Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) deployment, including machine connectivity, digital dashboards, predictive analytics, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) monitoring. Partner with Data Engineering on data pipelines, tags, and analytics use cases. Sponsor Industry use cases such as predictive maintenance, digital Statistical Process Control (SPC), and closed-loop process control. Deploy and maintain machine vision systems (*, Cognex, Keyence) for inspection, verification, and traceability. Support robot-PLC integration for FANUC and ABB cells, including safety, Human-Machine Interface (HMI), and I/O interfaces. Enforce High Voltage (HV) Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), HV Interlock (HVIL) continuity, and mandatory HV Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for work on or near EV Powertrain equipment. Comply with SASO, Saudi Ministry of Interior (MOI), and functional safety standards. Support HV emergency response, including thermal runaway isolation and battery-related incident procedures. Achieve and maintain HV safety competency appropriate to the scope of work. Architect PLC/HMI code, state machines, alarms, diagnostics, recipes, and recovery sequences; conduct peer review and enforce modular coding standards. Manage industrial networks, managed switches, addressing, interfaces, time synchronization, and end-to-end MES handshakes. Validate functional safety changes, safety requirement traceability, and proof-test evidence under formal authorization. Support FAT/SAT, commissioning, equipment acceptance, Safe Launch, run-at-rate, and capacity verification with objective evidence and disciplined punch-list closure. Control production, process, software, and test changes through documented risk assessment, approvals, validation, revision history, and rollback or containment planning. Participate in readiness reviews, Layered Process Audits, and Process Confirmation. Collaborate across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Manufacturing Engineering, EHS, IT/OT, MES, Supply Chain, Product Engineering, and suppliers. Apply role-specific HV LOTO/HVIL, machine safety, stored-energy isolation, electrical safe-work, and PPE requirements; ensure no bypassing of safety devices or product protections. Protect product genealogy, calibrated-tool status, test/measurement integrity, document control, and audit-ready objective evidence. Comply with applicable AMP-2, SASO, Saudi labor/EHS, IATF 16949, IEC 60204, and functional-safety requirements within the assigned scope. Build Saudi national capability through structured On-the-Job Training (OJT), Individual Learning Units (ILU)/skills matrices, practical assessment, certification, cross-training, and documented knowledge transfer. This includes medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays; and paid sick leave. A 401(k) retirement plan is also provided. Eligible employees may participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with applicable plan terms.

c9851f85f00885b0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ويضمن تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه عمليات تقدير الموازنات وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، مع ضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع المشاريع والبرامج الأخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد المتاحة، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها بفعالية. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وإغلاقه، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق كافة الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها إلى الأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لعمليات تطوير خطط تنفيذ المشاريع ومراقبة سير العمل. القدرة على وضع وتتبع الموازنات والإجراءات التعاقدية للمشاريع. مهارات ممتازة في تحديد التكاليف ومصادر التمويل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تحقيق أهداف المشاريع بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: المدينة المنورة. الراتب: لم يتم الكشف عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

Key Responsibilities Interact with guests in a positive and friendly manner, actively seeking opportunities to enhance their experience. Plan, organize, and execute various events, including breakfasts, coffee breaks, luncheons, dinners, cocktail receptions, and galas. Oversee the setup of function rooms, ensuring all items such as linens, silverware, glassware, and chinaware meet event specifications and quality standards. Supervise the breakdown of function rooms and ensure all equipment is properly stored for future events. Manage the Food and Beverage team, including scheduling, supervision, coaching, and recognition of performance. Ensure compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations to maintain guest and team member wellbeing. Required Qualifications A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant role. Demonstrated passion for hospitality. Ability to act with integrity and uphold ethical standards. Proven leadership capabilities. Strong commitment to teamwork. A sense of ownership and accountability in all tasks. Focus on immediate tasks with urgency and discipline to achieve impactful results. c98062cb08b5d49f.description: About the Role Halliburton is seeking a Project Coordinator for a full-time position in Al Qatif and Al Khobar. This role is designed for individuals who are driven to innovate, achieve, grow, and lead within the global energy industry. The Project Coordinator will be responsible for managing projects that require activity coordination for single to multiple rig projects, with a focus on efficiency and performance. Project Coordination and Scope The Project Coordinator will primarily handle projects with a limited risk profile, typically those without inter-Product Service Line (PSL) dependency, performance-based contracts, or extensive non-core third-party services. This position may also involve collaborating with a senior project manager on larger, more complex integrated projects, offering opportunities for learning and shared responsibilities. The role requires extensive coordination and management across various service lines and limited non-core third parties. Key Responsibilities Lead regularly scheduled meetings to review performance indicators and implement management systems to enhance efficiency. Actively participate in and lead operational problem-solving during execution, including investigations of Service Quality (SQ) events. Plan, organize, and coordinate projects for three or more Product Service Lines (PSLs) in adherence to company policies and procedures. Champion Halliburton's and the Customer's Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) regulations and guidelines. Verify that equipment received at the well site meets documented specifications and requirements. Ensure all third-party rental/purchase equipment has current inspection and testing documentation. Lead internal pre-project execution exercises (Drilling Well On Paper / Completing Well On Paper) and post-project review/close-out meetings. Participate in regularly scheduled project safety meetings and Business/Operations Performance Reviews. Conduct performance reviews in accordance with established PSL and Project Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Maintain detailed records of Daily Operations Reports in OpenWells, focusing on productive times and Non-Productive Time (NPT) classification. Ensure all Halliburton personnel work with the latest version of project procedures and expectations. Evaluate PSL operational performance and the applicability of technology offerings. Manage the project Performance Optimization Plan. Resolve all cross-PSL issues with the customer prior to final invoicing and report processing. Document and communicate lessons learned to the District and Project Leadership Team. Maintain a positive attitude, professionalism, discretion, and excellent communication skills, working effectively with diverse individuals across the organization. Demonstrate strong leadership skills and client interface capabilities. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in a suitable STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) field. A minimum of 3 years of related experience. At least 2 years of full-time experience in the oil and gas industry. Compensation Compensation for this role is competitive and will be commensurate with experience. Equal Opportunity Employer Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

c9dc958ad21625cc.description: About the Role Hill International (KSA) is seeking a PMIS (Unifier/P6) Admin to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah Region. This includes setting up and maintaining project structures, data hierarchies, user access controls, and security profiles. Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement upgrades, patches, and enhancements. Data Management: Manage project data within Unifier and P6, covering project schedules, budgets, contracts, and documents. Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across PMIS platforms. Develop and implement data management processes to streamline data entry, validation, and retrieval. User Support and Training: Provide technical support to project teams and users on PMIS functionalities and workflows. Conduct training sessions to onboard new users and enhance existing users' proficiency in Unifier and P6. Create user documentation, manuals, and guides for self-service support. Integration and Reporting: Coordinate integration efforts between Unifier, P6, and other project management tools. Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements, system enhancements, and automation within Unifier and P6. Recommend and implement best practices and methodologies to optimize project management processes and increase efficiency. Demonstrated ability to configure, maintain, and support complex project management information systems. Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, and execution processes. Experience in data management, ensuring integrity and consistency across platforms. Proficiency in developing reports, dashboards, and analytics. The role involves working within a project-oriented environment, providing essential support to project teams and stakeholders. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c94616361f05d0bd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث بيت الخبرة الأولى عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على التنفيذ لضمان مطابقة المواصفات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في المجال الهندسي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع لتحديد الجدوى الهندسية. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية للمشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية لضمان الدقة والامتثال. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع في الموقع ومطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات الفنية المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة درجة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تحليلية قوية ودقة في العمل. القدرة على الإشراف الميداني ومتابعة سير العمل. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص في بيت الخبرة الأولى، مع التركيز على تنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية بجودة عالية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في الرياض. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات الوظيفة.

c9d01e25a0660440.description: About the Role Nutanix is seeking an Enterprise Account Manager, Public Sector, to join its sales team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. c99a98e990c52e5d.description: About the Role Khatib & Alami is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer – Power & Lighting to join their team in Jeddah, Western Province. Prepare and review electrical load calculations, cable sizing, voltage-drop calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment schedules, and technical specifications. Perform lighting calculations and select suitable lighting fixtures and control systems to meet project requirements and energy-efficiency objectives. Ensure compliance with applicable Saudi codes, international standards, project specifications, and client requirements. Coordinate electrical designs with architectural, structural, mechanical, civil, and other engineering disciplines to resolve design conflicts and avoid clashes. Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate complex electrical design projects. Strong understanding of relevant Saudi codes, international standards, and safety regulations. c98920671aab1cca.description: About the Role Saudi Arabian Trading and Construction Company (SATCO) is seeking a Logistics Assistant to join one of its giga projects in Riyadh. Coordinate banksmen, flagmen, helpers, and access control around deliveries and mobile plant. Maintain clear roads, walkways, emergency routes, laydown areas, loading zones, and work-front access. Check lifting accessories and manual-handling arrangements within the team scope and report defects immediately. Verify attendance, productivity, housekeeping, and completion of assigned tasks. Escalate clashes, unsafe conditions, damaged materials, access restrictions, and resource needs to the supervisor. Participate in toolbox talks, inspections, and incident or near-miss reviews. Understanding of material movement, site access, and housekeeping procedures. c9d4a65f818db5ef.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن رسام معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية قراءة وتحرير ورسم المخططات المعمارية والإنشائية، سواء يدوياً أو باستخدام البرمجيات المتخصصة، بالإضافة إلى طباعة وتصنيف وتوثيق المخططات الهندسية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام مسودات الرسوم المعمارية والإنشائية ومناقشتها مع المهندس المختص لتفسيرها وإعداد الرسومات والتصاميم المعمارية والتنفيذية. رسم المخططات المعمارية والإنشائية والرسوم التنفيذية يدوياً باستخدام أدوات وطاولة الرسم. رسم المخططات الهندسية المعمارية والإنشائية والرسوم التنفيذية باستخدام برمجيات الحاسوب المتخصصة. تدقيق الرسوم وتقديمها للمهندس المعماري، وإعداد الرسوم النهائية وفقاً لتوجيهاته. طباعة المخططات النهائية باستخدام برامج الحاسوب وبمقياس الرسم المطلوب. تصنيف وفهرسة وتوثيق وترتيب وحفظ المخططات المعمارية والهندسية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الرسم المعماري أو ما يعادله. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والتصاميم المعمارية والرسوم الإنشائية. إتقان الرسم اليدوي للمخططات الهندسية. إتقان استخدام برمجيات الرسم الهندسي على الحاسوب. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب العمل ضمن فريق هندسي متخصص في مجال التجارة والمقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.
